email_subject: Application - Product Designer at EasyPost Connect
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Product Designer role at EasyPost Connect. Your focus on simplifying complex document workflows resonates with my experience turning technical complexity into clear, usable interfaces.

At Knowledge Experts, I helped build SharePoint-based digital workplaces for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores) and Aras Kargo (12,000 staff), designing structures that made enterprise tools accessible. As a freelancer, I designed and built baverok.com with accessible markup and a hand-coded landing page, and created a consistent layout for ~600 member profile pages at majistraleczacilari.org.tr. My front-end background (AngularJS, JavaScript) means I collaborate closely with engineers and understand implementation constraints.

I'm fluent in English and based in Belgium, available for the required office days in Grimbergen. My portfolio at baverok.com includes projects showing my process from discovery to delivery.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to EasyPost Connect.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Product Designer position at EasyPost Connect. Your mission to turn complex business processes into clear, intuitive experiences aligns with my work simplifying technical workflows and designing for real users.

At Knowledge Experts, I supported the team building SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores) and Aras Kargo (application gallery for 12,000 staff). This involved understanding how employees interact with enterprise tools and designing structures that make information accessible. As a freelancer, I designed and built baverok.com from scratch—including a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero, accessible markup, and a free site-check enquiry flow. For majistraleczacilari.org.tr, I created a consistent layout for ~600 member profile pages, ensuring scalability and usability. These projects required close collaboration with developers and iterative refinement based on feedback.

My front-end development background (AngularJS, JavaScript) gives me a practical understanding of technical constraints, enabling constructive collaboration with engineers. I'm fluent in English and based in Belgium, ready to work from the Grimbergen office at least three days a week.

I'm drawn to EasyPost Connect's focus on document workflows and delivery tracking—areas where clear interaction design can significantly reduce user effort. I'm eager to bring my UX thinking and visual design skills to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
